new_value: {"notes":"STATUS: Python\u003c-\u003eRust byte-parity PROVEN and deviations FIXED; Zephyr C side BLOCKED (see notes). Rust fixes: (1) pos.rs lat/lon records used u=\"deg\" instead of u=\"lat\"/\"lon\" (spec appendix-senml F.3; new SENML_LOCATION_UNIT_LAT/UNIT_LON constants in lichen-core). (2) bt was always 9-byte 0xfb f64 while oracle/python emit shortest-form int (0x1a66536a90); new canonical codec rust/lichen-senml/src/wire.rs (encode+decode) reusing senml-cbor Record/CborError. NOTE: upstream senml-cbor cbor::decode cannot parse 4/8-byte int args (dec_head caps info\u003c=25), i.e. it rejected the committed oracle bytes AND any Python-produced position pack - wire::decode replaces it on all Position decode paths. wire::decode enforces RFC8428 one-value-field rule (vector err-multiple-value-fields was silently accepted before); fixed skip_depth major-7 sizing bug (must use head size, not argument value). (3) Position::to_senml_cbor now rejects NaN/Inf + lat/[-90,90] + lon/[-180,180] matching python profiles.location and C senml_encode_location*. Tests: rust/lichen-client/tests/position_senml_vectors.rs (Position-level, all 12 vectors) + rust/lichen-senml/tests/location_vectors.rs (codec-level, incl oracle-\u003ere-encode stability) + 23 inline unit tests; oracle = test/vectors/senml_location.json (never code-under-test). All cargo tests green (lichen-senml 21+2+6, lichen-client 75+4+, lichen-core 300+), clippy clean, fmt applied; pytest senml_location_vectors+senml_resources 46 passed. ZEPHYR BLOCKERS in lichen/subsys/lichen/senml/senml.c (cannot build/test on macOS host; needs EC2 zephyr builder): a) duplicate definition of senml_encode_location_full (~L402 and ~L545) -\u003e compile error; b) zcbor_float32_put emits 0xfa f32 values vs oracle 0xfb f64 (byte-parity break vs python/rust); c) encode order BT-before-BN contradicts oracle (a2 21(bn)..22(bt)) and its own 'canonical CBOR ordering' comment (deterministic CBOR sorts 0x21\u003c0x22 =\u003e bn first); d) C uses float (f32) throughout so e.g. 37.774929f != f64 bits of oracle."}

new_value: Cross-implementation parity PROVEN for all three stacks (commit a98d7edcc0 on beads-worker-2). KEY FINDING: the four Zephyr C blockers in the bead notes were already fixed in the current tree — no production code change was needed: (a) single senml_encode_location_full definition; (b) encode_record uses zcbor_float64_put (0xfb+f64) not float32; (c) encode_base_record emits BN(-2/0x21) before BT(-3/0x22) with RFC 8949 §4.2.1 comment; (d) double parameters throughout + isnan/isinf/range validation matching Python profiles.location and Rust to_senml_cbor. The missing piece was PROOF: added test_location_oracle_vectors + test_location_oracle_encode_rejects to lichen/tests/senml/main.c — all 5 positive vectors from test/vectors/senml_location.json asserted byte-exact (accuracy-only was already covered by the pre-existing test; full/minimal/lat-lon-alt/with-base are new; minimal/lat-lon-alt use base_time==0 -> no base record, matching the Python absent-base-record shape), 4 encode-reject vectors mirrored with exact field values from the oracle and pinned error codes (-ERANGE/-EINVAL), plus boundary-accept probes at exactly (±90, ±180). Verified: host CMake suite 34/34 PASS (ASan+UBSan); negative control (range validation stripped -> reject tests fail; restored -> 34/34); all hex literals programmatically diffed byte-exact against the JSON oracle (independent oracle, never code-under-test); Python suite 46/46 PASS (test_senml_location_vectors + test_senml_resources); Rust green per bead notes. zcbor production path checked: modules/lib/zcbor zcbor_float64_put -> value_encode_len major-7 8-byte -> 0xfb+f64, same contract as the test stub. Codereview: 3 delegated kimi-k3 passes round 1 (correctness/oracle-integrity/edge) -> 3 minor findings (pin error codes, exact oracle reject values, boundary-accept case) all applied; round-2 convergence PASS.
